description: Stop and remove one or more AI processes (the temporary ones created by run_process / workspace_run) — the same as [dismiss] in the DevGlow UI. Use it to clean up processes you started once they are no longer needed. Does NOT apply to permanent projects; use delete_project for those. A pane that was showing a deleted process is left empty.

ids.description: AI process ids (call list_projects first; they are listed under 'AI Processes').

name: delete_process

unknown.description: Ids that are not AI processes; ignored.

title: Delete AI processes
